last_session.text: The party hired Drop Dead Ned for the Barrow Mound, and Ned offered Wayman 5 gold per goblin body.
The party opened Sir Brandon's tomb, and Sir Phidipaldi took the dragon slayer's sword and armor.
Sir Phidipaldi planned to carry out Dunk's scheme for the mithril chain shirt once the sword was won.
Sir Phidipaldi's dragon plan called for getting poison protection from the witch or the alchemist.
Goblins and a talking slime warned the party of a mad undead giant who cut down goblins.
Sir Phidipaldi, posing as Brandon's son, struck a bargain with the Free Goblin Society in the Barrow Mound.

open.text: Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.
Obtain protection against the black dragon's poison before going after the dragon.
Find the treasure marked on the party's map.
The undead giant swordsman who killed many goblins stands in the way of clearing the evil from the Barrow Mound.
George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales. Arrows and swords have all failed against them.
The Free Goblin Society would not want their dead defiled. Giving the goblin bodies to Ned means sneaking them past the goblins.
Sir Phidipaldi holds Sir Brandon's magical, uncursed sword, etched "All shadows yield to my light". Father William says only this sword can kill the dragon.
The party holds a jeweled ceremonial dagger, seven 50-gold candleholders, a 20-gold gold-toothed skull and five 100-gold urns. Dr. Uriah values the dagger at over 200 gold in a major city.
Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer with a little killer wasp, scouts and kills for the party in the Barrow Mound for a 100 gold fee.
Is the undead giant swordsman Alfred, Sir Brandon's shaggy companion with a greatsword in the mosaics?
Do the robes of Saint Arthur have magical properties? Dr. Uriah judged them uncursed but needs Ingrid's witch powder to test them.
Brother Dirk says the jeweled chalice was surely a gift to the church. Does it belong to the church, and will the party give it up?
Where did the new dragon near Brandonsford come from?
Why have shipments stopped reaching Brandonsford?
The party must clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society. In return, the goblins live there and let the party take Sir Brandon's goods.
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound for Father William.
The party must let Squints pick second from the Barrow Mound treasure, after the elite members.
Dr. Uriah must give Father William a 10 gold donation for the Barrow Mound's upkeep.
George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.
